lines.text: Your office Secret Santa... sorted. Everyone fills in a fourteen-question form. Stuck on a gift? There are ideas under ten, twenty, and thirty dollars. Twenty-four name slips, white elephant rules, and a dice swap game. Eleven pages. Instant download. Tap the link, and grab it on Etsy.

Eight games to get your family to midnight. No drinking games. Kids and grown-ups play together. Twenty trivia questions, with the answer key. Would you rather cards. Find the guest bingo. And 2027 predictions you check next year. Instant download. Tap the link, and grab it on Etsy.
